authorities.public: the digest-bound Koios static carrier served by cloudflare-worker:koios-news-primary on koios.news/*
authorities.persistentOperations: Cold Red Gate may carry clocks, ledgers, corpus state, newsroom execution, and other persistent services, but may not serve koios.news or any Koios public subdomain and is not a public origin, mirror, fallback, or rollback target
authorities.candidate: a production-shaped immutable body manifest held non-authoritatively until its delivery policy and Cloudflare deployment act are accepted
authorities.rollbackTarget: the last accepted Cloudflare deployment and route state, never a Cold Red Gate public origin

invariants: site-admin.config.json advertises no Koios VPS web endpoint
Cold Red Gate has no Caddy host block for koios.news or a Koios subdomain and no listener on the retired public-site port 18802
Koios public-site and newsroom web-unit templates remain absent from the carrier
a publication release changes public authority only through a digest-bound Cloudflare deployment receipt
persistent services return artifacts and receipts to Koios; they do not become public delivery authority
evidenceBinding: Every candidate, grant, deployment receipt, parity result, and rollback act names the exact static manifest digest, delivery-policy digest, Cloudflare account, Worker, hostname, and effect set.
Candidate body bytes and delivery policy remain distinct witnesses.
A latest-state reading without those bindings cannot transfer authority.

mutableRouteDisposition./healthz: A bounded Worker may answer artifact and deployment health only after its own grant.
mutableRouteDisposition./hit: Requires a separately contracted accountable-attention Worker, or an explicit suspension act paired with updated privacy text.
mutableRouteDisposition./views.json: Requires the same accountable-attention service and public aggregate contract as /hit.
mutableRouteDisposition./newsroom: Requires a separately admitted private operator carrier; persistence alone never grants a public Koios hostname.
mutableRouteDisposition./cable: Lives on a separately contracted authenticated ingress boundary.
mutableRouteDisposition./mcp: Lives on a separately contracted authenticated protocol boundary.
mutableRouteDisposition./operators: Lives on a separately admitted operator boundary.

rollbackMove: freeze publication and preserve the failed candidate, deployment receipt, and probe evidence
restore the last accepted Cloudflare Worker version and route state
purge only the failed candidate deployment cache under the accepted provider capability
probe root, feeds, sitemaps, privacy, standards, corrections, one live article, and health through public DNS
append the provider receipt, probes, elapsed time, and final Cloudflare authority to Koios's deployment ledger
limits: No credential, preview upload, route mutation, purge, deployment deletion, or rollback is authorized by this law alone.
Cold Red Gate persistence is not permission to serve public Koios bytes under an apex or subdomain.
Historical VPS-origin records remain evidence of prior state, not present authority.
